Name: 点金梦契
Description: 冷却3回合。支付25金币，获得5层{GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}，抽1张牌。若金币不足，改为获得4层{GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}和3层{GoldExp_goldexp_debt}。
Description_zh-Hant: 冷卻3回合。支付25金幣，獲得5層{GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}，抽1張牌。若金幣不足，改為獲得4層{GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}和3層{GoldExp_goldexp_debt}。
Description_en: Cooldown 3. Pay 25 gold, gain 5 {GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}, and draw 1 card. If you cannot pay, gain 4 {GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold} and 3 {GoldExp_goldexp_debt}.

Name: 黄金清算
Description: 冷却4回合。消耗所有{GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}，对敌方全体造成10+伪金*3点伤害。若有{GoldExp_goldexp_debt}，清算一半债务。
Description_zh-Hant: 冷卻4回合。消耗所有{GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}，對敵方全體造成10+偽金*3點傷害。若有{GoldExp_goldexp_debt}，清算一半債務。
Description_en: Cooldown 4. Spend all {GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold} to deal 10 + 3 per stack to all enemies. If you have {GoldExp_goldexp_debt}, settle half of it.
